content_of_post_to_comment: What I’m seeing here on Substack: AI made writing easier, so now everyone publishes more. There’s too much to read, so we use AI to summarize it and automate responses to articles. And then we publish again because the algorithm wants more. I’m not sure writing was the problem.
comment: The interesting shift may be that AI didn't just lower the cost of writing; it lowered the cost of ignoring. The scarce resource now might be attention and discernment, not content creation.
